text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Long ago, there existed a competition called the Unity Cup where teams competed in five race categories—sprint, mile, medium, long, and dirt.
color_text_info_list: sprint, mile, medium, long, and dirt

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While it didn't affect an Umamusume's official track record, the Unity Cup was still a heart-pounding event where racers triumphed, struggled, and worked together with companions.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After hearing Taiki Shuttle's impassioned appeal for the return of the event, Director Akikawa decides to reinstate the Unity Cup.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Unfortunately, Director Akikawa is suddenly called abroad, so management of the Unity Cup falls to the substitute director brought in to take over her duties.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But just what kind of person is Director Akikawa's temporary replacement?
